instruction: Cinematic film still, eye-level medium shot. Inside a dimly lit MMA gym with training cages and a red wall mural, the man in the black graphic t-shirt (R4) on the left stands with his back to the camera, arms raised defensively. Opposite him, the man in the black t-shirt (R2) on the right lunges forward in a dynamic boxing stance, throwing a punch with a focused expression. The two men spar closely in the center of the frame. Cool, dim ambient light with a bright spotlight from the upper right illuminates the sparring partners, creating a dramatic rim light effect against the hazy background.
